name: workskill
description: Distill employee-authored work methods into an evidence-backed personal wiki and validated reusable skills, inspired by WikiSkill.

interface.shortDescription: Turn work evidence into a personal wiki and reusable skills.
interface.longDescription: Incrementally import authorized Codex work records, distinguish employee methods from AI outcomes, maintain an evidence-backed wiki, and validate skills before activation. Includes a local capability report and an offline Python CLI.
defaultPrompt: 从我授权的 Codex 工作记录中蒸馏个人方法，更新知识 Wiki。
查看我的能力证据与 Skill 演化记录。
每天增量更新工作 Wiki，为新的方法提出 Skill 候选。
